by_village_id.map: function(doc) { if (doc.type === 'adl' && doc.administrative_regions_objects && doc.representative && doc.representative.email && doc.representative.is_active === true ) { doc.administrative_regions_objects.forEach(function(region) { if (region.villages && Array.isArray(region.villages)) { region.villages.forEach(function(village) { emit(village.id, null); }); } }); }}
